The agreement resolved differences between Andhra and Rayalaseema leaders regarding the future Andhra Province. s: In 1948 which Cornmission, in its report opined that creation of linguistic states is a threat to unity and integrity of the country
x:
The Dhar Commission, appointed in 1948, examined the issue of reorganizing Indian states on a linguistic basis. The Commission concluded that linguistic reorganization should not be undertaken immediately, arguing that it might endanger national unity, administrative efficiency and political stability. Its recommendations were later reconsidered by the J.V.P. Committee, and eventually the States Reorganisation Commission (1953) recommended linguistic reorganization.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).

s: In the second Vishalandhra Mahasabha held at Hyderabad in 1954 who out of the following strongly supported vishalandhra
x:
The Second Visalandhra Mahasabha, held at Hyderabad in 1954, strongly advocated the merger of Andhra State and Telangana into a single Telugu-speaking state. Swami Ramananda Theertha, one of the foremost leaders of the Hyderabad State freedom movement, strongly supported the idea of Visalandhra. He believed that the unification of Telugu-speaking people would strengthen cultural unity and promote balanced regional development. His support played an important role in building public opinion in favour of the merger, which eventually led to the formation of Andhra Pradesh on 1 November 1956.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
